# Photos

<!-- generated:header (isim/tools/coverage-summary.py; do not edit by hand) -->
**Symbols:** 49.4% of Apple's iOS API (346 of 701, exact) · **Rows:** 8: 4 ✅ 1 🟡 3 ❌ · **iOS:** 8.0+
<!-- /generated:header -->

**Area:** [Imaging, photos & ML](../COVERAGE.md#ml) · **Apple:** [Photos](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/photos) · **Issues:** [`area:ml`](https://github.com/kolabs-dev/isim/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aarea%3Aml)

## How isim implements it

- **Adapted:** a simulated photo library in `$ISIM_DATA/Media` (six generated pictures, plus the photos, videos and albums apps save), with the permission alerts.
- **Objective-C / C interface:** none yet (Swift only; #545).

## API

| API / feature | Status | iOS | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Photos (`PHPhotoLibrary`, `PHAsset`, saving images) | 🟡 | ≤17 | device library in `$ISIM_DATA/Media` seeded with 6 generated sample pictures (stand-ins for the Simulator's); permission alert (full / limited with selection / add-only) remembered per app; fetch with sort/limit and predicates (`mediaType`, `creationDate`, `favorite`, `pixelWidth`, …), smart albums (Recents, Favorites, Videos), `PHImageManager` scaling, `PHAssetChangeRequest` create/favorite/delete (with confirmation), change observers. Missing: Live Photos, `PHContentEditingInput` |
| Videos: `PHAssetChangeRequest.creationRequestForAssetFromVideo(atFileURL:)`, `PHAssetCreationRequest` `.video` resources, `PHImageManager.requestAVAsset(forVideo:options:resultHandler:)`, `requestPlayerItem(forVideo:options:resultHandler:)`, `requestExportSession(forVideo:options:exportPreset:resultHandler:)`, `PHVideoRequestOptions` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: movies are copied into the library with a poster frame (as `UISaveVideoAtPathToSavedPhotosAlbum` does), with their duration and size; requests give an `AVURLAsset` / `AVPlayerItem` / `AVAssetExportSession` over the library file on a background queue; isim keeps one version of each video, so `version`, `deliveryMode` and network access change nothing; no `AVAudioMix`; tested (HelloPhotos, test_photos_videos_albums) |
| Albums: `PHAssetCollectionChangeRequest` (`creationRequestForAssetCollection(withTitle:)`, `init(for:)`, `init(for:assets:)`, `title`, `addAssets`, `insertAssets(_:at:)`, `removeAssets`, `removeAssets(at:)`, `replaceAssets(at:withAssets:)`, `moveAssets(at:to:)`, `deleteAssetCollections`), `PHAssetCollection.fetchAssetCollections(with: .album …)`, `fetchAssetCollectionsContaining(_:with:options:)`, `PHCollection.fetchTopLevelUserCollections(with:)`, `canPerform(_:)` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: user albums kept in the library index, in their own order; fetch predicates and sorting on `title` / `localizedTitle`; the asset arguments take an `NSArray`, a `PHFetchResult` or placeholders (typed `Any`, where Apple's are `NSFastEnumeration`); no folders (`PHCollectionList`) or shared albums; tested (HelloPhotos, test_photos_videos_albums) |
| Resources: `PHAssetResource.assetResources(for:)`, `PHAssetResourceManager` (`requestData(for:options:dataReceivedHandler:completionHandler:)`, `writeData(for:toFile:options:)`, `cancelDataRequest`), `PHAssetResourceRequestOptions` | ✅ | ≤17 | adapted: each asset has one resource, its photo or video file (`.photo` / `.video`, with its type identifier); data comes in chunks on a background queue; `writeData` fails when the file exists, as on iOS; tested (HelloPhotos, test_photos_videos_albums) |
| `UIImageWriteToSavedPhotosAlbum` | ✅ | ≤17 | add-only permission alert, completion selector called with nil/error |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 17 and earlier) | ❌ | ≤17 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `PHCollectionList`, `PHLivePhoto`, `PHLivePhotoRequestOptions` (3 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 26) | ❌ | 26.1 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `PHAssetResourceUploadJob`, `PHAssetResourceUploadJobChangeRequest`, `PHBackgroundResourceUploadExtension` (3 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
| Types not yet in isim (iOS 27) | ❌ | 27.0 | not implemented, found by the 2026-10 sweep: `PHAssetExtendedMetadata`, `PHAssetResourceUploadJobOptions`, `PHBackgroundResourceUploadJobExtension`, `PHPhotoLibraryPersistentChangesObserver`, `PHReferenceImageInfo` (5 types; with their members under "Not yet in isim") |
